rules.why: Coverage for ordinary multifamily units turns on certificate-of-occupancy/construction timing and full versus partial Rent Ordinance status.
It applies to fully or partially Rent Ordinance-covered units, so ordinary multifamily coverage depends on that underlying coverage.
It expressly covers units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
It applies broadly to Berkeley residential rental applications or tenancies when the specified fees are charged.
It broadly covers Berkeley rental housing providers, with exemptions for owner-occupied small properties and special housing situations.
It covers Berkeley landlords and residential dwelling units without building-age, registration, or program-based limits.
